## Historical audit: H0107

**Scope.** Only chunk 1 of 2 is visible. The source is the student trajectory `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_08/lanes/codex_parallel_08_lane4/codex_parallel_08_lane4_I_r1/infer_logs/obsidian-linter-auto-table-of-contents/turn_1/trajs.json` (abbreviated **trajectory** below). The original task instructions are not visible, so an automatic table-of-contents rule is an inferred goal, not a complete specification.

| Evidence | Observation |
|---|---|
| H0107, trajectory, main_agent events 3–8 | The student attempted to branch from `main`; Git reported an invalid reference. A separate check found `auto-toc.ts` missing. The student created `auto-toc` from detached HEAD, which matched local `master`. |
| H0107, trajectory, events 9–40 | The student explored existing rule builders, ignore handling, execution order, heading regexes, registry loading and Markdown AST positions. This is visible autonomous repository exploration; its independence from any unseen teacher input cannot be established. |
| H0107, trajectory, events 43–46 | Successful writes created `src/utils/toc.ts` and `src/rules/auto-toc.ts`. The utility searches TOC markers, excludes code/math/YAML ranges, extracts headings and generates links; the registered rule exposes list, level, title, ID, formatting and exclusion options. These are observed implementations, not verified correct behavior. |
| H0107, trajectory, event 49 | An English localization edit was requested; its result is not visible in this chunk, so execution is not established here. |
| H0107, trajectory, top_level_metadata, characters [0,2751) | The final student report claims implementation and correction of initial dependency/build-convention problems, but says the later build/test, status and commit commands stalled. It cannot confirm tests or commit. The notification says the build/test task completed, but supplies no test result. |
| H0107, supplied file-inventory metadata | The recorded evaluation is `not_solved`, with 0/41 fail-to-pass and 1131/1131 pass-to-pass. The inventory records an 11,403-byte patch; its contents and individual evaluation failures are not shown. Thus this is a non-empty patch with formal failure and reported technical interruption, not established algorithmic failure. |
| H0107, trajectory, top_level_metadata, characters [0,2751); supplied teacher-material metadata | One teacher check is recorded, but no delivered teacher text appears in the visible observations. Available hint links and an after-round review do not establish receipt or adoption. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** The transferable observation is to distinguish repository inspection, successful file writes, completed checks and formal evaluation: none substitutes for the others. The task-specific approach combined marker-based replacement with regex heading extraction and AST-derived protected ranges; whether that approach caused the failing evaluation remains an unresolved hypothesis. The unseen second chunk may contain relevant execution, validation or teacher-delivery evidence; no conclusions about its contents are made. Scene-specific visual checks are not applicable to this software trace.
